$comment: Trail zones. mapCostCoin matches the named-upgrade table; null = not yet priced. requiredTool gates the zone's trail-map purchase behind a tool tier (design doc §3: Zone 2 flint, 3 copper, 4 bronze, 5 iron, deeper steel+); absent = ungated. verseSite is the quiet place where the zone's verse of the Rite is revealed (design doc §3/§7); required for mvp zones, authored later for the rest. Scope: mvp | v1.1 | v1.2
$foldGateNote: minMigration = folds that must be behind the warden before the trail exists at all (design §8); absent/0 = open from the first run. It gates the zone's trail map AND holds the zone's verse out of the Rite until then, so an early run is a SHORTER Rite over fewer zones rather than the whole map at a crawl. This is the one lever that answers 'I saw everything in a morning': the pacing knobs (demandGrowth, the breadth ramp) only change how fast the same six zones go by. Gate the ZONE, never its map rung — the rung inherits it, and the validator refuses a rung that carries its own fold. First guesses: the first three zones are the run-1 trail, then one new zone per fold to the Hollows on fold 3, so the full map is only walked from the fourth run on. Tune against a real run-1-to-run-5 sitting.
